title: Ice and Fire medieval rpg mod pack
description: Just a modpack including a collection of mods for ice and fire, medieval and adventuring
body:
Just a modpack including mods for world generation, boss fights, skill system and rpg classes. This is in preparation for Ice and Fire 2 and for personal server hosting. If anyone comes across this, enjoy!

uses stay true's texture pack https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true
